definitions.explanation: An extra class held to make up for a cancelled class or to provide additional instruction.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{休講|きゅうこう}→休講：19951_kyuukou⟧になった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{補講|ほこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The class was cancelled due to a typhoon, so a make-up class will be held.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{出張|しゅっちょう}→出張：01094_shucchou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{補講|ほこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}っている→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: Due to the teacher's business trip, a make-up class is scheduled for next week.

notes:
{補講|ほこう} is a compound of {補|ほ} (supplement) + {講|こう} (lecture). Refers to extra classes held to make up for missed or cancelled sessions.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {補講|ほこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to hold a make-up class
- {補講|ほこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: a make-up class is scheduled
- {補講|ほこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to attend a make-up class
- {補講|ほこう}⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧: make-up class period

USAGE:
Primarily used in university and school contexts. Make-up classes are typically scheduled when the original class was cancelled due to holidays, typhoons, or teacher absence.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{休講|きゅうこう}→休講：19951_kyuukou⟧: cancelled class
- ⟦{講義|こうぎ}→講義：01579_kougi⟧: lecture (university)
- ⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧: class (general)
- ⟦{補習|ほしゅう}→補習：09603_hoshuu⟧: supplementary lessons (remedial study)
